title: Action
description: An action Cortex suggests and the user approves. Each mode suggests its own types: follow_up_email (Focus), flashcards and notes (Student, saved to Google Drive), reminder (Life, Google Tasks), calendar_event (Google Calendar), message (a text through the Chert line), read_aloud (Assist), caregiver_summary (Assist: the daily summary emailed to a consenting caregiver, AST-6). Only follow_up_email and caregiver_summary carry an email draft; expense (Life: logs a receipt or purchase to the Expenses list, ACT-8); the other types carry their own optional payload (event, task, doc, message, expense).

status.description: sent and draft_saved apply to email and message; done to the other types.

mode.description: The mode that suggested it (a built-in or custom mode id).

title.description: Short verb-first title for the suggestion card, e.g. "Draft a follow-up to Ash".

summary.description: One-paragraph description for the suggestion card.

person_id.description: The person it concerns, or null (flashcards, notes, read aloud).

draft.description: The email draft. Always present when type is follow_up_email or caregiver_summary; absent for the other types.

event.description: calendar_event (ACT-5): the event to add to the user's primary Google Calendar.

task.description: reminder (ACT-6): the task to add to the user's default Google Tasks list.

due.description: Due date (Google Tasks keeps the date only).

doc.description: flashcards and notes (ACT-7): a Google Doc saved to the user's Drive. For flashcards, body holds one 'Q: ... / A: ...' pair per card.

message.description: message (ACT-9): a text sent from the Chert line. Only phones verified for the Chert project can receive it.

auto.description: True when Cortex ran it without asking because the mode's auto_run allows it (ACT-4). It is still receipted and undoable.

expense.description: expense (ACT-8): one entry for the Expenses list, from a receipt or something you said.

amount.description: Dollars; null when no total was readable.

external.description: Where a done or sent action landed, so undo can remove it. Absent until then; null on a dry run.
